### [ChatService.tsx](file:///c%3A/Users/demig/Documents/vulcano/vulcano-fe/src/services/ChatService.tsx)

Aggiungi le chiamate API al backend per la chat, supponendo che tu abbia endpoint come `/chat/send`, `/chat/history`, ecc. Adatto per l'uso con `fetch` o una libreria come `axios`. Qui uso `fetch` per semplicità.

````typescript
const API_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8000"; // Cambia se necessario

export async function sendMessage(message: string, userId: string) {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/send`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message, user_id: userId }),
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Errore nell'invio del messaggio");
    }
    return response.json();
}

export async function getChatHistory(userId: string) {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/chat/history?user_id=${encodeURIComponent(userId)}`);
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Errore nel recupero della cronologia chat");
    }
    return response.json();
}

// Aggiungi altre chiamate se hai altri endpoint, ad esempio per cancellare la chat, ecc.
// ...existing code...
````

````typescript
import apiClient from "./apiClient";

// Ottieni una domanda per ID
export const getQuestionById = async (questionId: number) => {
  const response = await apiClient.get(`/chat/questions/${questionId}`, { withCredentials: true });
  return response.data;
};

// Ottieni tutte le domande di un utente
export const getQuestionsByUserId = async (userId: number) => {
  const response = await apiClient.get(`/chat/questions/user/${userId}`, { withCredentials: true });
  return response.data;
};

// Inserisci una nuova domanda
export const insertQuestion = async (payload: { conversation_id: number; user_id: number; content_file_id?: number }) => {
  const response = await apiClient.post(`/chat/questions`, payload, { withCredentials: true });
  return response.data;
};
````

Queste funzioni corrispondono agli endpoint REST definiti in `routes/chat.py`:

- `GET /chat/questions/<question_id>` → `api_get_question_by_id`
- `GET /chat/questions/user/<user_id>` → `api_list_questions_by_user_id`
- `POST /chat/questions` → `api_insert_question`

````typescript
import { apiClient } from "./ApiClient";

// --- INTERFACCE ---

// Una domanda (question) come restituita dal BE
export interface Question {
  id: number;
  conversation_id: number;
  user_id: number;
  content_file_id?: number | null;
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
}

// Request per inserire una domanda
export interface InsertQuestionRequest {
  conversation_id: number;
  user_id: number;
  content_file_id?: number;
  content: string;
}

// Response per GET /chat/questions/<id>
export interface GetQuestionByIdResponse extends Question {}

// Response per GET /chat/questions/user/<user_id>
export interface GetQuestionsByUserIdResponse {
  questions: Question[];
}

// Response per POST /chat/questions
export interface InsertQuestionResponse {
  id: number;
}

// --- API CALLS ---

export const getQuestionById = async (questionId: number): Promise<GetQuestionByIdResponse> => {
  const response = await apiClient.get(`/chat/questions/${questionId}`, { withCredentials: true });
  return response.data;
};

export const getQuestionsByUserId = async (userId: number): Promise<GetQuestionsByUserIdResponse> => {
  const response = await apiClient.get(`/chat/questions/user/${userId}`, { withCredentials: true });
  return response.data;
};

export const insertQuestion = async (payload: InsertQuestionRequest): Promise<InsertQuestionResponse> => {
  const response = await apiClient.post(`/chat/questions`, payload, { withCredentials: true });
  return response.data;
};
````

Queste interfacce sono allineate con la struttura degli endpoint in `vulcano-be/routes/chat.py`.
